questions.promptMd: After the harness executes a tool, what does it send back to the model on the next call?

options.textMd: Nothing; the model remembers the call
A new system prompt containing the result
A message with role `tool` containing the result, appended to the conversation
The result inside the next user message only

questions.explanationMd: The model is stateless between calls, so the observation has to travel in the transcript. A `tool` message keeps it distinguishable from something the user said.

questions.promptMd: Which of these belong **server-side**, even though the model was already given the tool's JSON Schema? Select all that apply.

options.textMd: Validating the tool arguments against the schema
Checking the tool name against an allow-list
Deciding how nicely to phrase the final answer
Enforcing a timeout on tool execution

questions.explanationMd: The schema is a prompt, not a constraint: the model may still emit a wrong name or malformed arguments. Anything that protects the system has to be enforced where the execution happens.
